yt.title: Fold paper 42 times and it passes the Moon #Shorts
yt.description:
A 0.1 mm sheet doubled 42 times: 0.1 mm x 2^42 = {c_km} km. The Moon is about 384,400 km away on average. A thought experiment; real paper cannot be folded that many times.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Take a sheet of paper and imagine folding it forty two times.

scenes.label: thick, in theory: a 0.1 mm sheet doubled 42 times
scenes.narration: Paper is about a tenth of a millimeter thick, and every fold doubles it. After forty two folds, it would be about {c_km_say} kilometers thick.
The Moon is about three hundred eighty four thousand kilometers away. Doubling is powerful, even if no real paper can be folded that many times.
